headlines.text: Flash back to 2022, when Chris Jericho vs. Bandido went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.18 ? a genuinely great match. For Bandido, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. In his first ROH title defense, Jericho no-sold the Code of Honor handshake, then survived a returning Bandido's suplex-hold display before making him submit to the Walls of Jericho.
On this day in 2022, Juice Robinson made their first appearance under the AEW banner against Jon Moxley, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.52.

Flash back to 2022, when the AEW Women's World Title was up for grabs as Toni Storm vs. Serena Deeb went to war in a Lumberjack match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.70. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2022, when Bryan Danielson vs. Matt Menard crossed paths for the first time ever, setting the tone as the night's opener on Dynamite, rated 4.66.
